naming.class_type: Lua module table wx.<ClassName> (e.g. wx.wxFrame) - a metatable-backed wrapper table holding the raw pointer in _ptr
naming.constant: Name resolved lazily from require("kwxffi_constants_gen"), e.g. ID_ANY, DEFAULT_FRAME_STYLE
naming.constructor: Dotted module function: wx.wxFrame.Create(parent, id, text, left, top, width, height, style)
naming.event_bind: Bind lives on the wxEvtHandler module (wxevthandler_gen.lua) and is inherited by every window: M:Bind(first, last, type, closure).  The id form passes the id as both first and last
naming.method: Colon method on the wrapper handle: handle:Method(...).  A receiverless (static) class function uses a dot: M.Name(...)
naming.module: kwxffi_idiomatic_gen, which re-exports each per-class <classname>_gen.lua module and kwxffi_freefuncs_idiomatic_gen

events.handler_type: function(event_ptr) - a Lua closure wrapped in a wxClosure and passed as Bind's closure argument; event_ptr is the raw wxEvent pointer the handler receives
